...FLOOD WATCH NOW IN EFFECT UNTIL MIDNIGHT MDT TONIGHT...

* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues to be
  possible although the risk will decrease into the evening as
  stronger showers and thunderstorms diminish.

* WHERE...The eastern San Juan Mountains and Upper Rio Grande Valley.

* WHEN...Until midnight MDT tonight.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may exacerbate flooding of rivers,
  creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
  - Waves of showers and isolated embedded thunderstorms will
    continue into the evening.  Although rainfall will be more
    limited in coverage, localized amounts of up to 0.5 inches could
    cause additional minor rises in the smaller creeks and
    tributaries.
  - The eastern San Juan Mountains and Upper Rio Grande Valley with
    the greatest risk across Conejos County.
  - http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

PRECAUTIONARY/PREPAREDNESS ACTIONS...

You should monitor later forecasts and be alert for possible new
Flood Warnings. Those living in areas prone to flooding should be
prepared to take action should flooding develop.
